The '''Eighty-third Platoon''' was a unit in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Labe]] was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]], but a mission led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Xak Herral]] to recover a stolen [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] ended with Herral's entire group [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces.
